user.title: KR Ledger
user.description: Pick the Android companion app `Last notification` sensors to read card and bank notifications from. Personal text messages are filtered out and never stored.

data_description.notification_sensors: Settings > Companion app > Manage sensors > Last notification. Allow-list your card, bank and SMS apps there.
data_description.owner_names: Used to recognise transfers between your own accounts, e.g. 홍길동. Masked forms like 홍*동 are matched automatically.
data_description.import_days: Recorder keeps about 10 days. 0 = start from now.

error.no_sensor: Select at least one notification sensor.

abort.single_instance_allowed: KR Ledger is already set up.

data_description.extra_packages: Android package names of other financial apps whose notifications should be read.
data_description.dedupe_minutes: One payment reported by SMS, card app and Samsung Pay within this window is merged.
data_description.raw_retention_days: Original notification text is deleted after this many days. Ledger entries are kept.

import_history.name: Import history
import_history.description: Read past notifications from the recorder into the ledger. Safe to run again.

add_transaction.name: Add transaction
add_transaction.description: Add a manual ledger entry (cash etc.).

reprocess.name: Reprocess unrecognised
reprocess.description: Run the current parser rules again on notifications waiting for review.
